patterns.note_zh: 不但…而且…（连接两个对等成分；A/B 词性须一致）

examples.plain: He is clever and he works hard.
examples.patterned: He is not only clever but also hard-working.

examples.plain: The movie was exciting and it was moving.
examples.patterned: The movie was not only exciting but also moving.

traps: *He not only likes sports but also football.

patterns.note_zh: 要么…要么…（就近谓语：谓语与 B 一致）

examples.plain: You can take the bus or the subway.
examples.patterned: Either the bus or the subway takes you there.

examples.plain: He is either lying or mistaken.
examples.patterned: Either he is lying or he is mistaken.

patterns.note_zh: 一…就…（no sooner 置首须部分倒装；than 引导后半句）

examples.plain: As soon as he arrived, the meeting began.
examples.patterned: No sooner had he arrived than the meeting began.

examples.plain: Hardly had she left when it started to rain.
examples.patterned: No sooner had she left than it started to rain.

traps: *No sooner he arrived than the meeting began.
*No sooner had he arrived than the meeting started to rain.

patterns.note_zh: 宁愿…也不…（than 前后动词形式一致）

examples.plain: He prefers walking to taking the bus.
examples.patterned: He would rather walk than take the bus.

examples.plain: She likes staying home better than going out.
examples.patterned: She would rather stay home than go out.

traps: *He would rather walk than to take the bus.
*I would rather to stay than going.

patterns.note_zh: 早该…了（从句用过去时表虚拟）

examples.patterned: It is high time we took action.
It is high time he left.

traps: *It is high time we take action.
*It is high time that we will take action.

patterns.note_zh: 直到…才…（not until 置首主句部分倒装）

examples.plain: He did not realize the truth until much later.
examples.patterned: Not until much later did he realize the truth.

examples.plain: She did not go home until midnight.
examples.patterned: Not until midnight did she go home.

traps: *Not until much later he realized the truth.
*Until much later did he realize the truth.

patterns.note_zh: 越…越…（定冠词 the 不可省，前后结构平行）

examples.plain: If you practise more, you will improve faster.
examples.patterned: The more you practise, the faster you will improve.

examples.plain: Books become more useful when they are read more.
examples.patterned: The more books are read, the more useful they become.

traps: *The more you read, faster you write.

patterns.note_zh: 只要（引导条件从句，时态用一般现在时表将来）

examples.plain: You will succeed if you keep trying.
examples.patterned: You will succeed as long as you keep trying.

examples.plain: If the weather is fine, we will go.
examples.patterned: As long as the weather is fine, we will go.

traps: *As long as the weather will be fine, we will go.
*As long as keep trying, you will succeed.
